'''Dandrian Ring''',<ref name="EGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> also called '''Dandrian's Ring''', was a [[Planetary ring/Legends|ring]] of [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dandrian]].<ref name="Challenge" /> It was located in the [[Belderone sector/Legends|Belderone sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==Description==
The [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] of Dandrian's Ring were the remnants of a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] that struck the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dandrian]] during its formation. [[Alpha-Omega]] was the largest asteroid in the [[Planetary ring/Legends|ring]].<ref name="Challenge" />

==History==
In the aftermath of the [[New Sith Wars]], during the [[Unification Campaigns]] of the [[900s BBY]], the final battle of the [[Belderone Contention]] took place at the Dandrian Ring. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] fought with distinction at the [[Battle of the Dandrian Ring]], bringing the conflict to a violent end.<ref name="EGtW" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Alpha-Omega was the site of the [[Alpha-Omega Prison]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] top-security [[Prison/Legends|prison]].<ref name="Challenge" />
